in_sanskrit.name: Garajan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Chariot of Lord Vishnu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Garajan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Garajan is derived from Sanskrit. It is a devotional name meaning 'Chariot of Lord Vishnu'. In Hindu mythology, Garuda is the king of birds and the mount of Lord Vishnu. This name represents courage, power, and devotion.
